# Sl3 Int Generated By Order Two And Three

Kourovka 14.49 (M. Conder): `SL₃(ℤ)` is a quotient of the modular group `PSL₂(ℤ) ≅ C₂ ∗ C₃`,
that is, `SL₃(ℤ)` is generated by an element of order `2` and an element of order `3`.
